architectureDecisions: ProductHistoryHead is the canonical completeness cursor per product: CAS {generation, commitRef, historyDigest} over immutable ProductHistoryCommit records.

History contains accepted closure-relevant product transitions (semantic claim/obligation currentness, release/quality currentness, accepted product revisions, acceptance-policy/waiver revisions), not execution policy/strategy/attempt changes.
RESEARCH_SA may inspect BB-052/BB-054 READY plans only as PLANNED_DEPENDENCY; WORKER waits for BB-054 DONE and consumes delivered truth.

Closure-relevant publishers, projection reads and closure commit share a project mutation guard. Authority/history mismatch after crash is RECOVERY_REQUIRED/NOT_READY until deterministic reconciliation.
Each history commit binds predecessor generation/digest and exact authority-head observations; fresh reconstruction validates chain continuity.
ProductAcceptanceAuthority stores immutable policy/waiver artifacts behind a CAS head and derives the complete applicable waiver set; callers cannot supply a subset.
ProductProjectionSubject pins exact history generation/digest plus acceptance-policy head/ref and waiverSetDigest.
ProductStateProjection is a deterministic disposable reduction of the complete canonical subject; its API accepts no selected claim/obligation/quality/waiver refs.
ProductOutcomeClaim is immutable evidence outside ProductHistory. Closure revalidates the exact projection subject under history/policy guards immediately before commit.
A historical outcome is current only if its pinned subject still equals current history/policy/waiver state; later product changes stale it, while strategy-only changes do not.
implementationSlices: G1 — Product history store/controller [AC-1, AC-2, AC-5, AC-7, AC-8, INV-1, INV-2, INV-4, INV-8]. Add product-history.js with productHistorySubjectKey(productId), createProductHistoryController({artifactStore,headStore,mutationGuard,authorityReaders}), appendTransition(...), current(...), withCurrentHistoryGuard(...), reconcile(...). ProductHistoryCommit stores previousCommitRef, generation, previousDigest, historyDigest, transitionRefs[] and observed closure-relevant authority heads. Integrate delivered C semantic-head and E/F release/quality-head mutations through the same project guard. product-history.test.js proves monotonic CAS/immutable chain and strategy-only exclusion; product-history-recovery.test.js kills between authority mutation/history append and requires RECOVERY_REQUIRED until reconcile appends the exact immutable transition.

G2 — Acceptance-policy authority [AC-6, AC-8, INV-6]. Add product-acceptance-policy.js with createProductAcceptanceAuthority({artifactStore,headStore,mutationGuard}), publishPolicy(...), publishWaiver(...), resolveCurrent({productId}). Artifacts are immutable; one CAS head pins policyRef/revision and canonical applicable waiver refs. Resolver sorts/deduplicates applicable waivers and returns waiverSetDigest. No public API accepts caller waiverRefs. product-state-projection.test.js covers omitted-waiver resistance; product-revalidation.test.js covers policy/waiver head drift.

G3 — Deterministic projection builder [AC-1, AC-2, AC-4, AC-5, AC-6, INV-1, INV-3, INV-6]. Add product-state-projection.js with createProductStateProjectionBuilder({productHistory,acceptanceAuthority,artifactResolvers,artifactStore}). build({productId,rootIntentRef}) acquires current history/acceptance observations, validates the history chain, reduces current SemanticClaim/CrossDomainObligation/DeploymentRelease/QualityAcceptance state, derives unresolved blocking obligations and blockers, then stores ProductProjectionSubject + content-addressed ProductStateProjection. Public input has no claimRefs/obligationRefs/qualityRefs/waiverRefs. product-state-projection.test.js proves omitted rejected claim/obligation cannot disappear and cache deletion/rebuild yields identical subject/readiness/activeSetDigest/blockers.

G4 — Closure commit fence [AC-3, AC-6, INV-4, INV-5]. Add product-closure.js with createProductClosureController({projectionBuilder,productHistory,acceptanceAuthority,artifactStore,outcomeHeadStore}), close({projectionRef}) and currentOutcome({productId}). close resolves the stored projection, acquires the same project history mutation guard and acceptance-authority guard, re-reads exact generation/digest/policy revision/waiverSetDigest, requires equality with ProductProjectionSubject plus ELIGIBLE_FOR_CLOSURE, writes immutable ProductOutcomeClaim, then CAS-advances latest-outcome head. product-closure.test.js covers success/not-ready; product-closure-race.test.js uses barriers to prove Hn+1 or policy drift before/during final commit yields no current outcome.

G5 — Historical outcome revalidation [AC-7, AC-9, INV-5, INV-7]. currentOutcome resolves latest immutable ProductOutcomeClaim and current ProductProjectionSubject; it returns CURRENT only when subjects match and rebuilt readiness remains eligible. product-revalidation.test.js closes at Hn, publishes a new accepted closure-relevant revision to Hn+1 and proves old claim still resolves but is HISTORICAL; then separately changes ExecutionPolicy/ExecutionStrategy with unchanged accepted lineage and proves ProductHistoryHead/closure currentness do not move.

G6 — Fresh-process integration proof [AC-1..AC-9, INV-1..INV-8]. Export controllers/stores from index.js and persist with createJsonImmutableArtifactStore/createJsonCasHeadStore. product-completeness-chain.test.js creates canonical C lineage + E/F quality inputs, restarts controllers from disk, rebuilds one identical projection, closes it, advances product history and acceptance policy independently, revalidates historical outcome, and attempts in-place mutation of claim/obligation/history/outcome artifacts expecting immutable-conflict failure. Run cross-domain-regression, deployment-qa-regression and agentic-regression to prove G does not weaken delivered C/E/F authority.

evidenceRequired: Canonical history derives rejected claim; caller omission stays NOT_READY.
